title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre - Stanford University on 1982-10-09
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/88.2k) -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC/24 (1 DVD FLAC)
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Outstanding outdoor audience recording that captures a high‑energy performance with superb versions of Dupree, Big River, and Eyes.
ai_review.review: The recordings are praised as crystal‑clear, almost studio‑quality audience tapes recorded in perfect outdoor conditions, delivering an accurate sense of being in the venue.  The band’s playing is described as “rocked” and the renditions of Dupree, Big River and Eyes are highlighted as especially impressive, with only a minor note about a slightly boxy low end.

ai_rating.rationale: All six reviews are strongly positive, emphasizing excellent sound quality and good performance; the few minor critiques (boxy bass) keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Recorded outdoors with an ideal mic placement, delivering crisp, accurate sound; a handful of listeners note slight boxiness and reduced bass but overall the mix is clear and balanced.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers focus on overall energy and song quality.
